source: Claude independent learner QA: W1–W14; N1–N20; valid F00–F14 variants

excludedFaults.F10: Invalid injection: Chromium restores dialog focus without trigger.focus()

notes: These rows are requirements, not unverified claims of PASS. A defect is VERIFIED only with pre-fix failure, normal PASS, negative FAIL, student export where relevant, and matching SHA evidence.

W1.note: Old /pr-preview/pr-45/ route is 404; show verified Cloudflare preview entrance instead.

W2.note: AI cloud onboarding should list required network destinations and offline alternative.

W3.note: Interview text and ZIP must match byte for byte; literal escaped newline sequences must not appear.

W4.note: Planner rename/reorder must update aria-label and preserve focus.

W5.note: Botanical palette accent contrast risk; distinguish decorative versus text use.

W6.note: Placeholder/demo content gets NOTICE, not a blocking technical FAIL.

W7.note: Hidden decorative ↗ in MobileMenu must not create a false navigation mismatch.

W9.note: MobileMenu IDs deterministic; nested labels and focus must remain accessible.

W10.note: Custom navigation path applied consistently to links, footer, hero and verifier.

W11.note: FeaturedWorkSection cards with URLs clickable as entire card; without URLs remain noninteractive.

W12.note: Starter-onboarding Skill numbering and document outline valid.

W13.note: Docs warn that historical immutable Cloudflare Previews retain withdrawn content.

W14.note: Cloudflare connector may lack Pages write rights; documented Dashboard fallback required.

N1.note: Planner keyboard move/reorder preserves same button focus.

N2.note: SelectedPatterns editorial footer must honor nav.path instead of nav.id.

N3.note: Home Hero primary CTA must honor nav.path instead of nav.id.

N4.note: Reserved articles route cannot be customized unless all generated articles move accordingly.

N5.note: Standalone Starter exporter must reject generated broken internal links.

N6.note: Student output checker must catch broken links, JSON/draft leaks, short CJK titles, and search/index omissions.

N7.note: Editorial audit must not falsely fail valid keyboard skip-link patterns.

N8.note: Editorial audit must fail real low-contrast body text instead of returning 0/WARN.

N9.note: Editorial Reveal must not leave permanently invisible content; audit scroll and inspect it.

N10.note: Long multi-line H1 audited consistently with visual checklist.

N11.note: Generated footer text and touch targets comply with readable minimums.

N12.note: Skill reflects Pagefind build reality; 404/noindex pages excluded from index.

N13.note: Starter brand, Block and Editorial design tokens are bridged consistently.

N14.note: Planner provides editable friendly custom page path and validates it.

N15.note: Low-contrast alternate palettes handled for foreground use.

N16.note: Scrollable #plan-preview is keyboard focusable with accessible name.

N17.note: SiteSearchDialog closes on first Escape even with typed query.

N18.note: H01 recipe has no placeholder href=# and uses customizable caption.

N19.note: Student PR CI runs core output verification, not Astro build only.

N20.note: Canonical entry prompt consistent across /guide/, START-HERE and README.

F00.note: Unmodified clean student site baseline must pass all applicable validators.

F02.note: Missing mobile menu entry must FAIL.

F11.note: Missing search/exact-zh.json or Pagefind must FAIL.
